cards.text: What the model can use, one turn step by step with its guards, and the work that spans several agents.

cards.title: Tools and skills
cards.text: A tool is a C# method the model calls; a skill is markdown in its prompt telling it how and when.

cards.text: The model thinks, calls tools through the guards, and streams its answer; the whole turn is kept.
